original.target_description: Study 4 is identified, but the description physical cleansing and guilt does not uniquely establish a test. Study 4 reports both compensatory volunteering and a moral-emotions composite including guilt; no guilt-only test is printed.

notes: Primary source title and authors verified: Zhong and Liljenquist, Science 313 (2006), pp. 1451–1452; supplied JSTOR published-article OCR. Only the assigned original side was examined. The source contains both volunteering and composite moral-emotions tests. The neutral description and page locator do not uniquely establish the assigned outcome/test; statistics left null.
